Confusion and vomiting after generator use need immediate help. CO is odorless and colorless, and fuel-burning generators, stoves, grills, charcoal, or gasoline engines can poison people in enclosed or partly enclosed spaces or near open windows. Move people to fresh air now and stop the device only if it is safe to do so. For headache, dizziness, weakness, nausea, vomiting, chest pain, confusion, fainting, or several people ill together, seek urgent help now.
